info.title: Amrutam Telemedicine API
info.description:
Production-grade telemedicine backend.

**Conventions**
- Errors follow RFC 7807 `application/problem+json`.
- Mutating money/slot endpoints require an `Idempotency-Key` header; replays return the original response with `Idempotent-Replay: true`.
- Lists use opaque cursor pagination (`?cursor=&limit=`).
- Every response echoes `X-Request-Id` for support correlation.
- Rate limits are advertised via `RateLimit-*` headers; 429s include `Retry-After`.

password.description: Min 12 chars with upper, lower, digit and symbol.

totp.description: TOTP code, required when MFA is enabled.

refreshToken.description: The opaque refresh token returned by /auth/login.

notes.example: Patient reports improvement. Continue triphala for two weeks.

bio.example: Ayurvedic practitioner focused on digestive health.

chiefComplaint.example: Recurring acidity and bloating for three weeks.

newSlotId.description: Target slot (must belong to the same doctor).

amount.description: Partial refund amount. Defaults to the full amount.

reason.example: Patient cancelled within the refund window

advice.example: Avoid cold drinks; walk 20 minutes after dinner.

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 7807 problem document — the error shape for every non-2xx response.

Idempotency-Key.description: Client-generated unique key (UUID recommended). Required on all mutating money or slot endpoints. Replaying the same key with the same payload returns the original response; a different payload under the same key returns 409.

Idempotent-Replay.description: Present and set to `true` when the response was served from the idempotency store.

X-Request-Id.description: Correlation id echoed on every response; quote it in support requests.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, sent with every 429.
